'''Traze Lasfer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] individual living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Voss]], where he built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.
